risks.title: Concurrence intense et pression sur les marges
risks.score_rationale: Principal risk identified in risk factor summary describing highly competitive business environment with pressure on sales and results of operations. Direct impact on core financial performance metrics. Citation: "On a comparable currency neutral basis, Food Ingredients sales decreased 3% in 2025 compared to". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: The company faces intense global competition with large multinational competitors and agile new entrants that exert pressure on pricing and margins.

risks.title: Exécution de la transformation stratégique et risques de fusions‑acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Material adverse effect risk explicitly stated regarding inability to execute strategic transformation or manage collaborations, joint ventures, acquisitions and divestitures. Recent $1.153B goodwill impairment demonstrates realized impact. Citation: "A key factor for commercial success is our inclusion on strategic customers core supplier lists". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Failure to successfully execute strategic transformation initiatives or integrate acquisitions could materially harm financial condition and operating results.
risks.title_en: Strategic transformation execution and M&A risks

risks.title: Enquêtes antitrust et contentieux collectif
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing antitrust investigations and related class action lawsuits explicitly mentioned as material uncertainties in risk factor summary. Potential for significant legal and financial consequences. Citation: "=== IFF_2026-02-27.htm.gz === Item 1A, Risk Factors Our results of operations may be negatively impacted". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Ongoing antitrust investigations and class action lawsuits could result in substantial fines, penalties and restrictions on business operations.
risks.title_en: Antitrust investigations and class action litigation

risks.title: Data breach or major IT system disruption
risks.score_rationale: Significant data breach or IT disruption identified as risk that could disrupt operations and result in loss of confidential information. Material operational and reputational impact. Citation: "Segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA is defined as (Loss) Income Before Taxes before depreciation and amortization". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: A major information technology breach or system disruption could interrupt operations and result in loss of confidential data and reputational harm.

risks.title: Volatilité des coûts des matières premières et intrants
risks.score_rationale: Increases in input costs including raw materials, transportation and energy have been exacerbated by recent inflationary pressures. Direct impact on gross margins which declined from gross profit impact of $264M from divestitures. Citation: "We are on the core supplier lists of a large majority of our global and". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Increases in raw material costs, energy and transportation expenses, amplified by recent inflation, pressure margins and competitiveness.
risks.title_en: Volatility of raw material and input costs

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Geographic diversity with sales across multiple countries and currencies creates structural exposure. Exchange rate impact on 2025 sales was less than 1% but represents ongoing headwind. Citation: "We provide currency neutral calculations in this report to remove the impact of foreign currency". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates can reduce reported revenues and impact financial performance across international operations.

risks.title: Risques liés à l'application de l'intelligence artificielle
risks.score_rationale: Emerging risk explicitly identified regarding potential legal and operational liabilities from mismanaged AI applications. Represents new area of concern as adoption increases. Citation: "Segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA is defined as (Loss) Income Before Taxes before depreciation and amortization". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Mismanagement of artificial intelligence applications could expose the company to legal liabilities and operational risks.

risks.title: Conformité environnementale et coûts de durabilité
risks.score_rationale: Increasing regulatory pressure and investor expectations on sustainability and environmental performance. Risk of facility closures or sanctions for non-compliance with strengthening environmental regulations. Citation: "While we have historically paid dividends on a quarterly basis to shareholders of our common". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Non-compliance with environmental standards or failure to meet sustainability expectations could result in substantial costs, sanctions and facility restrictions.

company_description: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets food, beverage, health and biosciences, scent, and complementary adjacent products in the United States, and internationally. It operates in through Taste, Food Ingredients, Health & Biosciences, and Scent segments. The Taste segment offers savory products such as soups, sauces, meat, fish, poultry, snacks; beverages consists of juice drinks, carbonated or flavored beverages, spirits; sweets comprising, bakery products, candy, cereal, chewing gum; and dairy products, such as yogurt, ice cream, cheese, and other products, as well as spices and seasoning ingredients for meat, food service, convenience, alternative protein and culinary products. The Food Ingredients segment provides natural, artificial, and plant-based specialty food ingredients; natural antioxidants and anti-microbials used for natural food preservation and shelf-life extension for beverages, cosmetic and healthcare products, pet food and feed additives; and savory solutions, such as spices, marinades, and mixtures, and inclusion products comprising  combining flavorings with fruit, vegetables and other natural ingredien
